  • Method Details

    • createAndSaveThumbnail

      @Async CompletableFuture<ThumbnailMetadata> createAndSaveThumbnail(Path filePath, String encodedFileName, long fileId, UserDTO userDTO) throws IOException
      Async function, creates and saves thumbnails to their file location and database table. Uses defaults, If there is already and thumbnail entry for a file then it replaces it by changing thumbnail file name.

      Saves thumbnails to their folders by dimensions like "horizontal" and "vertical".

      Parameters:
      filePath - File path of the file to create thumbnail of
      encodedFileName - File's BASE32 encoded file name
      fileId - File's File Metadata ID
      userDTO - General User credentials such as: ID, username and mail. Used as "alternative" for background task runners to access scope specific variables
      Returns:
      Completable future, async function thread can be awaited or its result can be ignored
      Throws:
      IOException - If an I/O error occurs

    • nuclearDeleteAllThumbnails

      DeletionResults nuclearDeleteAllThumbnails() throws IOException
      Deletes all by I/O thumbnails and database whether they exist in database or not. Can be used to fix issues when API returns duplicate entries pointing to same file.
      Returns:
      Deletion Result object which shows how many were successful and failures.
      Throws:
      IOException - If an I/O error occurs

    • deleteThumbnailByFileIDAndSetThumbnailStatus

      void deleteThumbnailByFileIDAndSetThumbnailStatus(long fileId) throws SQLException, IOException
      Wrapper function over delete by fileID function. It deletes thumbnail and switches related File's "has_thumbnail" from true to false.
      Parameters:
      fileId - File's fileID to delete
      Throws:
      SQLException - If the file metadata entry or thumbnail database entry doesn't exist or an error occurs
      IOException - If the thumbnail can't be deleted due to I/O error
